name: claudeconnect
notes: Your Claude Code chats are on the site: the ones you started in the terminal or the desktop app are listed with the ones you started here, you can open any of them, and carry on from where it left off. Chats started on the site are Claude Code's own, so everything stays in step.
On a phone, the Claude / Claude Code switch and permission mode now sit on their own row at the bottom of the message box.
The pencil in the top corner is gone. New chat is in the sidebar.
